ranked.headline: Single-cell model claims hinge on split design and donor-held-out generalization
ranked.summary: Foundation models for single-cell omics now span multimodal completion, perturbation prediction, and proteomics, prompting stricter evaluation.

ranked.headline: Upstream normalization, probe design and spatial testing shape single-cell readouts
ranked.summary: Recent snRNA-seq, spatial and multiome methods are being applied to disease-linked brain cell states, making upstream analytic choices consequential.

ranked.headline: Interpretable methods attribute gene programs to cell types and spatial niches
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics now yield per-molecule, per-niche, and per-cell-state readouts that require interpretable inference.

ranked.headline: Curated resources and workflows consolidate cross-platform spatial transcriptomics data
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell datasets now span many platforms, so standardized workflows and queryable databases are needed for reuse.

ranked.headline: Learned and mechanistic models infer single-cell state dynamics from lineage context
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair dynamical models of single-cell states with lineage tracing, gene regulatory networks, and biological constraints.

ranked.headline: Modeling interaction-induced conformational change and weighted biomolecular ensembles
ranked.summary: Structure modeling is shifting from static bound geometries toward unbound-to-bound transitions and experimentally weighted conformational ensembles.

ranked.headline: Curated databases tie structures to binding affinities and conformational ensembles
ranked.summary: Benchmark-ready structural databases are being updated now to serve machine-learning training, evaluation, and flexibility-aware modelling.

ranked.headline: LLM agents for biology depend on scaffolding, grounding, and bounded workflows
ranked.summary: Biomedical LLM agents are now tested on grounded tasks, from sequencing protocols to protein binder design and evidence weighing.

ranked.headline: Models infer glioblastoma invasion dynamics from MRI and single-cell imaging
ranked.summary: Single time-point MRI and ex vivo single-cell tracking now yield interpretable glioblastoma invasion parameters from limited acquisitions.

ranked.headline: Conditioned models predict peptide structure, protein function, and RNA interactions
ranked.summary: Protein language models and conditioned architectures are being tuned for mutation effects, kinase substrates, enzyme classes, and RNA design.

ranked.headline: Genetic variants and sequence shape cell-type-specific chromatin and gene expression
ranked.summary: Single-cell QTL and footprinting datasets now resolve variant effects on regulatory activity across cell types at population scale.

ranked.headline: Uncertainty-aware and benchmarked statistical methods reshape microbiome inference
ranked.summary: Recent work benchmarks microbiome inference methods against ground truth while modeling compositional uncertainty and individual context.

ranked.headline: Curated databases now resolve cell markers, enhancers, lncRNAs, and gene redundancy
ranked.summary: Updated curated resources now pair experimental evidence with AI-assisted search and extend coverage to new species and gene-redundancy reasoning.

ranked.headline: Read-level methylation models separate tumor cfDNA from jagged-end artifacts
ranked.summary: Fragment-end-aware methylation scoring and jagged-end error correction now operate at single-read resolution in cfDNA sequencing.

ranked.headline: Domain-constrained sequence tools accelerate DNA and RNA inference and design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published package report streamlined algorithms for sequence reconstruction, RNA structure scanning, and probe design.

ranked.headline: Pretrained sequence models adapted to single-cell and individual-level genomic readouts
ranked.summary: Sequence-to-function models are being fine-tuned for single-cell readouts while variant-calling and benchmarking tools mature in parallel.

ranked.headline: Databases link non-coding variants to target genes and population allele frequencies
ranked.summary: Recent resources integrate QTL catalogs, multiomic evidence and population allele frequencies to prioritize regulatory and non-coding variants.

ranked.headline: Spatial transport and reaction-diffusion models across neural and glial scales
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published benchmark extend excitable-cell and reaction-diffusion modeling to pulsed fields, channel kinetics, and glial geometries.

ranked.headline: Web and R tools for visualizing and integrating multilayered omics networks
ranked.summary: Public STRING and IntAct network data and transcriptomic or proteomic datasets are now reachable through interactive web and Bioconductor platforms.

ranked.headline: Integrated multi-omics resources link molecular features to clinical and drug outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent atlases and databases pair single-cell, multi-omic and bulk data with clinical annotations, intervention outcomes and drug sensitivity.

ranked.headline: Curated knowledgebases organize bacterial, arthropod and annelid microbiome genomic data
ranked.summary: Reference resources now span 32 866 bacterial genomes and host-associated metagenomes, while long-read 16S workflows resolve beetle symbiont composition.

ranked.headline: Computational models prioritize antibacterial targets and guide treatment decisions
ranked.summary: Mechanistic and learned models now output decision-level results: target pairs, candidate rankings, and gonococcal treatment guidance.

ranked.headline: Generative binder design pairs structure proposals with humanness and epitope evaluation
ranked.summary: Structure-aware generation is now paired with verification, humanness scoring, and label-based evaluation that expose limits of current design pipelines.

ranked.headline: Simulations model condensates and chromatin phases as driven, non-equilibrium systems
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained and mesoscale models now link condensate dynamics to synaptic, kinase-driven, and epigenetic phase behavior.

ranked.headline: ML models prioritize small molecules by activity, selectivity, and ADMET endpoints
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark training protocols and foundation-scale models for small-molecule activity, selectivity, and ADMET prediction.

ranked.headline: Structural variation and transposon dynamics shape genome expansion across lineages
ranked.summary: Graph pangenomes and forward simulators now resolve structural variants and transposon dynamics across bacterial and fungal genomes.

ranked.headline: Local learning and low-rank subspaces explain model-brain alignment
ranked.summary: Recent work tests whether local learning rules and interpretable features explain how well models align with ventral-stream and language-cortex recordings.

ranked.headline: Packaged inference tools for RNA kinetics, regulatory networks, and protein interactions
ranked.summary: Single-cell and omics datasets now support GPU-accelerated, condition-aware inference across kinetics, networks, and interactions.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked isoform quantification tools sharpen transcript-level RNA-seq analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a new proteogenomics pipeline target isoform ambiguity in large long-read and full-length cDNA datasets.

ranked.headline: Checking generative and predictive model outputs against measurement references
ranked.summary: Three recent preprints evaluate model outputs against explicit biological or measurement references rather than accepting them as opaque.

ranked.headline: Histology-based prediction of spatial and single-cell transcriptomes from tissue images
ranked.summary: Recent preprints fuse H&E histology with spatial transcriptomics or proteomics to infer unmeasured spatial molecular layers from routine tissue images.

ranked.headline: Controlling training form and guidance locality for generative design under limited data
ranked.summary: Under limited labeled data, the representation, guidance locality, or reward used by generative models now serves as the main performance lever.

ranked.headline: Learned prioritization of protein mutations, residues, and viral k-mers
ranked.summary: Protein language models and conformal methods now yield calibrated, attributable scores for ranking mutations and sequence features.

ranked.headline: Whole-genome doubling tracked across cancers, subclones and normal tissues
ranked.summary: Large pan-cancer and tissue-scale datasets now resolve whole-genome doubling's drivers, selection, and hidden subclonal presence in tumours.

ranked.headline: Linking metabolic traits, genetic association and medication-adjusted GWAS phenotypes
ranked.summary: Large-scale metabolomics and GWAS resources now support mediation, disease prediction, and confounder-adjusted genetic analysis of metabolic traits.

ranked.headline: Molecular dynamics and HDX-MS resolve structural dynamics in proteins
ranked.summary: Open-source hydrogen-bond tools and multi-ensemble HDX-MS reweighting now link MD ensembles to experimental deuterium data.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models embed evolutionary and chromatin structure in genome prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers test whether evolutionary or 3D genome structure improves sequence-based genomic prediction.

ranked.headline: Bursty gene expression shapes rhythm transmission, timing precision and information flow
ranked.summary: Analytic frameworks now link bursting, degradation and dose-response shape to rhythm, timing and information transmission in gene expression and signaling.

ranked.headline: Computational models map catalytic RNAs, protein communication and DDX3X dsRNA unwinding
ranked.summary: Computational predictions of RNA and protein mechanisms are being tested against validation benchmarks as simulation and deep-learning methods mature.

ranked.headline: Absolute yeast proteomes link subcellular protein allocation to growth rate
ranked.summary: Absolute quantitation of 300 yeast proteomes now resolves how protein allocation across compartments tracks growth physiology.
